Viscount of Oxfuird is a title in the Peerage of Scotland created in 1651 for Sir John Maitland, 1st Baronet, a prominent Scottish statesman and lawyer. The title is associated with the lands of Oxfuird, which are located in the county of East Lothian, Scotland.  Sir John Maitland was a member of a prominent Scottish family, serving as a Lord of Session, a Lord of the Articles, and a Lord Commissioner of the Treasury. He played a key role in negotiations leading to the Union of the Crowns of Scotland and England in 1603.  The 1st Viscount of Oxfuird was succeeded by his son, John Maitland, 2nd Viscount of Oxfuird, who served as a member of the Scottish Privy Council and as Lord Lieutenant of Haddingtonshire. The 2nd Viscount's son, Charles Maitland, 3rd Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent military leader and General during the War of the Spanish Succession.  The 3rd Viscount's son, John Maitland, 4th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent politician and served as a member of the British Parliament for several years. He was also a noted patron of the arts and sciences and was a close friend and supporter of philosopher David Hume.  The 4th Viscount's son James Maitland, 5th Viscount of Oxfuird, was a prominent diplomat and served as the British Ambassador to the Netherlands and France. He was also a noted collector of art and rare books. And his collection is now housed in the National Library of Scotland. Selective Publication in Nature: An Empirical Analysis of Abstracts from the Journal of Statistical Genetics Abstract, We investigate selective publication of papers in Nature Genetics. On one side we analyze the frequency of abstracts in Nature Genetics articles using a logistic regression model, finding significant differences by author, issue and field; No significant difference is observed between journals. On the other hand, we compare publications based on geographic location and type of journal issue (only or top specialization); Similar results are presented; New analyses and possible explanations are discussed; The first part of the analysis is performed using a logistic regression model. Two hypotheses for potential effects are proposed  -  (i) journals tend to publish manuscripts of the same quality in the same field, and (ii) journals publish only manuscripts with no papers or few original articles. In the second part, we examine manuscripts by author, issue and geographic region. It is shown that patterns differ for abstracts versus no abstracts, controlled for publication status and authorship and geographic location. The study will be discussed at a conference in October 2014.

The novel chronicles Stevens, a butler at Darlington Hall who has dedicated his life to serving his master Lord Darlington. Set in the 1930s, the story begins with Stevens in his mid-50s and has been working at Darlington Hall for over 30 years. He is deeply devoted to his work and takes great pride in his profession, believing that a butler's role extends beyond mere service to provide continuity and tradition in an evolving world.  Despite his dedication, Stevens faces numerous challenges. He has few close relationships outside of work and his only companion is his father, who is also a butler at a nearby estate. As the novel progresses, Stevens's father becomes ill, forcing him to confront the reality of his own mortality and the choices he has made in life.  Simultaneously, Stevens finds himself entangled in events that challenge his beliefs about his role as a butler and his relationship with his master. Lord Darlington, a wealthy and influential man, is a Nazi sympathizer, prompting Stevens to grapple with moral implications of serving such a man. As political tensions escalate in Europe, Stevens must decide where his loyalties truly lie and what he is willing to do to uphold his sense of duty and honor.  Throughout the novel, Stevens grapples with questions of identity, loyalty and morality all against the backdrop of rapidly changing times in the 1930s. Reflecting on his life and past decisions, he confronts both personal and historical legacies. The narrative explores profound themes of human nature, duty, loyalty and identity, offering a poignant and thought-provoking examination of the human condition.

I have been binge watching Bob Ross videos and I must say I absolutely love his soothing voice and calming presence. He is truly a talented artist and watching him create beautiful landscapes is incredibly inspiring. However, there is one minor issue that I have noticed with his paintings. While I appreciate the simplicity and accessibility of his techniques, sometimes I feel like the end results can be a bit too similar. I love his signature style with the happy little trees and fluffy clouds. But after watching several episodes, the paintings start to blend together for me. I would love to see him experiment with different subjects or styles to mix things up and keep the audience engaged. Nonetheless, this is just a tiny gripe compared to the overall joy and relaxation I get from watching Bob Ross paint.

The Lobster is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human relationships and societal norms. Set in a dystopian future, the movie presents a world where single people are forced to find a partner within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. The film's premise may seem absurd at first, but it serves as a clever allegory for the pressures and expectations placed upon individuals in our society.  The movie's protagonist, David, played by Colin Farrell, is a recently divorced man struggling to cope with the new world order. He is sent to a strange hotel where he must navigate a series of bizarre rituals and encounters with other singletons, all vying for love and acceptance. The hotel's residents are a fascinatingly eccentric cast of characters, each with their own unique quirks and backstories.  The film's pacing is deliberate and measured, allowing the audience to fully absorb the eerie atmosphere and sense of unease that permeates every frame. The cinematography is stark and haunting, with a muted color palette that adds to the overall sense of bleakness. The score is equally effective, utilizing unsettling sound effects and discordant music to heighten the tension and unease.  The performances in the film are outstanding, with Colin Farrell delivering a particularly strong turn as the protagonist. His portrayal of David's desperation and confusion is both heartbreaking and uncomfortable to watch, making for a compelling and nuanced performance. The supporting cast is equally impressive, with standout performances from Rachel Weisz and Olivia Colman.  The Lobster is not an easy watch, but it is a challenging and uncomfortable film that asks difficult questions about the nature of love, relationships, and societal conformity. It is a deeply thought-provoking and intelligent work that lingers long after the credits have rolled. It is a film that will leave you questioning your own beliefs and values.

In a forgotten land, a city long lost to time and legend stands at the heart. For centuries, adventurers have searched for its mythical streets, seeking treasures beyond imagination and answers to mysteries past. Yet, none have found a single crumbling wall or rusted piece of metal from the past.  As the years pass, hope dwindles for those seeking the lost city's secrets. That is until a young archaeologist named Sarah stumbles upon a map that could be the key to its location. With nothing but her wits, determination, and a small team of loyal companions, Sarah embarks on a perilous journey to uncover the city's secrets.  Sarah and her team navigate treacherous terrain, battling dangerous creatures and navigating deadly traps, in search of the lost city's location. As they uncover the city's secrets, they discover that the civilization that once thrived there was far more advanced and advanced in technology and knowledge than anyone had previously thought possible.  As they delve deeper into the ruins. Sarah and her team discover that the city's downfall was not due to natural disasters or external forces, but rather internal corruption and greed. With each new discovery, Sarah and her team come closer to unlocking the city's secrets and piecing together the story of its rise and fall.  In this thrilling adventure, Sarah and her team must use all of their skills and resources to stay one step ahead of their enemies and solve the puzzles left behind by the lost city's inhabitants. Will they succeed in finding the city and uncover its secrets, or will they become another victim of the treacherous landscape and the dangers that lurk within?

The ministry has its sights set on the United States, with sources close to the matter indicating that the U.S. is the top candidate. It is also believed that other central bankers, such as Andy Haldane and Andrew Bailey of the Bank of England, could also be considered. Despite the ongoing tensions with the United States over Israeli settlement policies, Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has assured that the two countries' relations are strong and positive.

This study introduces two innovative methods for multi-organ segmentation using deep learning. Both techniques utilize the concept of leveraging multiple input planes as parallel channels, allowing different supervision schemes to be defined for each plane. This approach enables the information flow to better handle ambiguous signals from partial or irrelevant annotations (semi-supervision), and to enhance generalization to test images with occluded or rotated organs. The study combines a convolutional autoencoder for RGB channels to extract features and a 3D ResNet for T2w/FLAIR subtraction to convey anatomical details. This approach enables the efficient representation of both appearance and geometry using complementary domains, providing significant performance improvements over standard methods. The study's results show marked improvements over seminal MICCAI publications, with a quantitative comparison on five public datasets demonstrating that the proposed methods exceed state-of-the-art scores, achieving results comparable to human experts with a simple modification of the backbone architecture.

The South African government has announced plans to reopen its embassy in Mauritius, ending a 20-year diplomatic standoff between the two countries.  The decision was made following talks between President Cyril Ramaphosa and Prime Minister Pravind Jugnauth, who met on the sidelines of the African Union summit in Ethiopia last week.  Mauritius had accused South Africa of supporting separatist rebels in the Indian Ocean island nation during the 1980s and 1990s. This led to the closure of the South African embassy in Port Louis in 1997.  In recent years, relations between the two countries have improved significantly, with both sides working together to combat piracy and promote regional stability.  South Africa's foreign ministry said that the reopening of the embassy would help strengthen bilateral ties and boost economic cooperation between the two nations.  "We believe that this is an important step towards normalising our relationship," said spokesperson Clayson Mbatha. "It will allow us to engage more actively with each other on issues of mutual interest."  Mauritius welcomed the move, saying it hoped to deepen its engagement with South Africa, and benefit from increased trade and investment.  "This is a positive development for our region as a whole," said Foreign Affairs Minister Alain St. Ange. "We look forward to further strengthening our partnership with South Africa."

James W. Truman (1863-1942) was an American businessman and philanthropist who built his fortune in the railroad industry, specifically as the president of the Manhattan Elevated Railway Company. Truman was renowned for his generous donations to various causes in New York City, including hospitals, educational institutions, and cultural organizations. His contributions to the city were so significant that many buildings and facilities were named in his honor, including the James W. Truman Public School on West 123rd Street. Which opened in 1913 and continues to serve students to this day. Truman also established the James W. Truman Foundation in 1924, which continues to support educational programs in New York City to this day.

This paper introduces the concept of witness structures and immediate snapshot complexes, as a method to analyze the combinatorial structure of simplicial complexes. Witness structures are an extension of simplicial complexes that allow for representation of higher-dimensional combinatorial structures. Immediate snapshot complexes are a specific type of witness structure that capture the combinatorial structure of a system at a particular point in time. The paper presents algorithms for constructing these structures along with techniques for analyzing their properties. The authors illustrate the practical applications of these concepts through various real-world examples, including social networks and biological systems. Overall, this paper offers a novel framework for studying complex systems, and provides new insights into their behavior.

Asparagus with Prosciutto di Parma Pecorino Pepato and Poached Eggs  Ingredients  -  1 bunch asparagus (about 1 pound) 6 large eggs 4 tablespoons unsalted butter 4 thin slices prosciutto di Parma torn into pieces 1/2 cup grated Pecorino Pepato cheese 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/2 teaspoon white pepper 1/4 teaspoon salt  Instructions 1. Bring a pot of water to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, fill a large bowl with ice water and set aside. Cut the tips off the asparagus and set aside. Cut the stalks into 1-inch pieces and set aside. Blanch the tips in the boiling water for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the tips to the ice water and chill for 1 minute. Drain, pat dry, and set aside. Blanch the stalks for 4 to 6 minutes or until tender. Drain, pat dry, and set aside. 2. Crack the eggs into individual ramekins or cups. Fill a large skillet with water and add the white vinegar. Bring the water to a simmer over medium heat. Carefully slide the eggs into the water and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked as desired. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the eggs to a towel to drain. 3. Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the prosciutto and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the ham is crisp. Add the asparagus and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until tender-crisp. Add the cheese and cook for 1 minute or until melted. Stir in the heavy cream, pepper and salt and cook for 1 minute or until heated through. 4. To serve, divide the asparagus and prosciutto among individual plates. It starts with the introduction of a new town; It is a little quaint, and people look healthy; The book is about its residents and their lives compared to how things used to be.  The novel is about a fictional detective's time and experience; He is referred to as "Detective Caul" and begins with him and his friend discovering a body in the woods. They call the police on themselves and their friend, who tells them that Caul might not be guilty. The detectives ask Caul to meet them at a tavern, but he refuses, implying he has a case. After some time, Caul shows up to the tavern and asks if the man who discovered the body is still involved in the case. The detectives agree to talk to him before arresting Caul, but after getting the information, Caul is shot in the head, solving the mystery. However, the book does not reveal who killed Caul, only hints towards the suspect. Then it jumps to the next book, where the killer is discovered, killed similarly to Caul's friend, and there is a trial; Caul is acquitted. The narrator says, "It should have ended like it did." The book ends with Caul telling his story to a class, asking two questions, which is did he kill his friend? Was a man already involved in one of his friends' murder also responsible for killing Caul?  This makes me think this is a true novel, not a cheap fantasy novel. There are elements in the writing style that make me believe it's real rather than a cheap literary novel; I believe the author, "Caul," wrote this series to get a small piece of the $3 billion and $5 billion yearly fantasy market currently enjoyed by Rowling. The author created a well-drawn version of what it would be like to be in the world of a detective. He established Caul and his friend, and what would have happened if they hadn't met.

Italy's Parmalat founder Calisto Tanzi admits to accounting errors at the dairy firm he led for three decades, apologizing for "infinite damage" caused. The firm collapsed in December when it admitted falsifying accounts by 15 billion euros. Tanzi's empire is being sold to Brazilian rival Vigor Alimentos and Asian assets are being sold. He wants to find solutions for the firm's future and make reparations, but it cannot be bailed out. Tanzi's statements come amid news of investors being given interest-free loans instead of dividends. Parmalat, Italy's largest food company, was forced into administration in December, when it failed to raise the promised funds for a bond repayment of $500 billion. At a recent meeting with Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi and other top politicians, Tanzi admitted "errors and non-transparency" in accounting practices. Berlusconi demanded more and called Tanzi's statements "insufficient," with the possibility of a ban on Tanzi's future positions at other Italian companies.

This paper explores resource allocation in MIMO radar systems with multiple targets for non-coherent localization. The problem is addressed as an optimization problem to minimize the mean squared error in target localization. The study examines the effects of key system parameters,  -  the number of transmit and receive antennas, the number of transmitted signals, and the sampling rate, on radar system performance. An efficient algorithm based on the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed resource allocation scheme significantly enhances the radar system's localization accuracy compared to conventional methods.

This paper introduces CIDI Lung-Seg, a single-click annotation tool for automatically delineating lungs from CT scans. The tool uses a pre-trained deep learning model to identify and segment the lungs in scans with just a single click; A blinded, controlled study comparing its performance to manual annotation found high agreement (96.2% overall) and a kappa statistic of 0.87. The tool also saves significant time, with an average time saving of 87.2%. This method has the potential to greatly reduce the time required for manual lung cancer annotations.

This device has the power to control and manipulate the human mind; However, Raghunath's invention falls into the wrong hands when a powerful corporation, led by the ruthless businessman, Varadarajan, steals the technology; Raghunath becomes a fugitive, hunted by Varadarajan's henchmen. With the help of his loyal friends, Raghunath embarks on a dangerous journey to reclaim his invention and expose the corporation's sinister plans. Along the way, he encounters a group of rebels who are fighting against the oppressive regime. Together, they form an alliance to bring down Varadarajan and restore freedom to the people. The novel explores themes of power, corruption, and the ethical implications of advanced technology. It delves into the moral dilemmas faced by the characters as they grapple with the consequences of their actions. En Iniya Iyanthira is a gripping and thought-provoking tale that keeps readers on the edge of their seats, questioning the boundaries of science and the human mind.

Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical analysis and computer aided diagnosis. Unlike 2D images, 3D medical images offer more detailed structures and robust segmentation capabilities. However, effectively utilizing the rich information in 3D medical images remains a challenge. This paper introduces UXNet, a novel deep learning architecture for 3D medical image segmentation; UXNet employs a unique upsampled encoder-decoder network with a multi level feature aggregation mechanism. This mechanism enhances the spatial information by upsampling low level features and captures complex structures by aggregating multi level features; UXNet learns more robust representations, improving segmentation accuracy; Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets including ISLES2017, LLC and SYNAPSE BREAST CT, show that UXNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The source code and models are available at https //github.com/CCF-Union/UXNet.

Nigeria plans to significantly boost its cocoa production over the next decade, aiming to increase its cocoa bean output by 50% by 2030, according to President Muhammadu Buhari. The country aims to remove barriers to irrigation and fertilizer use with current annual cocoa production at 340,000 tonnes making it the world's fourth-largest producer behind Ivory Coast, Indonesia and Ghana. The president has pledged to make Nigeria the world's top cocoa producer. However, critics argue that past efforts have failed. And the government needs to clarify if the promised increase will be achieved by converting rainforest land into cocoa farms or by intensifying fertilizer use. Nigeria's tropical forests, home to endangered species like chimps and pangolins, are threatened by deforestation. And the government has previously promised to return 1 million hectares of land to forests annually. But few measures have been implemented.
